spots.name: Marietta Landing
spots.description: South-end public ramp. Best when wind blows from the south or west.

spots.name: Tipps Point
spots.description: Mid-lake point on the west shore. Protected from east wind.

spots.name: Tucker Tower
spots.description: Iconic east-shore landmark. Glass on west wind days.

spots.name: Anadarche Cove
spots.description: Deep west-shore cove. Strong protection from north and east wind.

spots.name: Blue Creek Arm
spots.description: Narrow southeast finger. Sheltered from north winds.

spots.name: Bee Creek
spots.description: East-shore creek arm. Glass when wind is from the west.

spots.name: Rock Creek
spots.description: Northeast cove. Tight, sheltered from the prevailing south wind.

spots.name: North Shore
spots.description: North-end open water. Best on south wind days.
